_comment: Step rubric for /agent-triage and /agent-work on Acme Stream Co.

fields.agent_next_step: One-line read-only action naming a concrete target, or null when none exists.
fields.agent_step_check: Human checkpoint before the result is trusted, or null.
fields.agent_step_as_of: ISO date the step was last set or re-confirmed; null = never assessed.

warehouse.what: BigQuery queries against acme_analytics.* and governed metric catalog (GOVERNED_REPO).
examples: Count duplicate trial_started events per user_id in acme_analytics.events for the last 7 days

definition_audit.what: Read-only audits of config/context, config/schemas, and sibling dbt repo.
examples: Verify invoice line_type enum in acme_invoices matches finance spec

precondition_check.what: Read-only Jira lookups that settle whether a precondition has happened.
examples: Check ACMECHK-142 fixVersion: if deployed, re-run pay-flow step funnel gap query

not_a_step: Writing to Confluence, Jira, or Slack

concreteness_bar.rule: agent_next_step must name at least one concrete target.

accepted_targets.table_or_metric: your-gcp-project.acme_analytics.<table> or a registered metric name
